name: Kotomi Nichibotsu
source:
Kotomi Nichibotsu, sister of Eri Nichibotsu, is one of Saturday's close friends. She is 23 at the beginning of vivid/stasis.

[spoiler]It is later revealed that Kotomi, along with Eri, was transported to the simulated world from another world in the world axis.[/spoiler]
